prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for single-test kinds of changes (adoption layout, choose_path redesign, finish layout, sign_in redesign, sign_in reorder).
Redesigning adoption screens (adoption, redesign) consistently worked well and proved helpful.
Copy changes in choose_path (choose_path, copy) consistently made performance worse.
Notification toggles (home, notification) and waiting step info (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect.
Adding new screens at the finish step (finish, new_screen) showed no clear positive effect and hurt performance.
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measured results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: -0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +5.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -4.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: -1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -4.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, notification: +1.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +0.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -7.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 73.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 22.5%

"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Split layout redesign for pet pick friend screen: Redesign the friend selection screen into a split layout showcasing animated mascot interactions alongside pet choices. (why: Adoption screen redesigns consistently improve funnel conversion and help users make clearer pet choices.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive custom pet feature design step: Add an interactive pet customization screen before photo upload to configure pet colors and traits. (why: Support received 3 reports of custom pet creation failing or looking wrong; giving structured customization options prevents generation errors.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Grid layout redesign for choose path screen: Redesign the choose path selection layout into a structured visual grid without altering text copy. (why: Choose path step has a high mean time of 514s; structural grid presentation clarifies options while avoiding negative copy redesign effects.)
3: [home, redesign] Stage layout redesign for waiting screen: Redesign the pet setup waiting screen layout into a stage format featuring interactive pet animations. (why: The waiting step has a long median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s; a stage layout keeps users engaged while waiting.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account pet sync hint on sign-in screen: Add an explicit hint explaining that signing in saves and syncs pets across reinstalls. (why: Support received 8 emails complaining about pets missing or resetting after signing back in.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop tray control hint on finish screen: Add a guidance hint explaining how to access the pet from the system desktop tray. (why: Support received multiple tickets (3 emails) from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Official adoption license badge component: Add an official adoption seal badge onto the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption step overall retention can be strengthened with visual completion rewards, building on proven adoption redesign gains.)
7: [sign_in, layout] Centered layout redesign for sign-in screen: Switch the sign-in screen layout to a clean centered view. (why: Two support emails reported the sign-in screen stalling or failing to load properly on setup.)
8: [finish, layout] Full bleed layout redesign for home intro screen: Change the home intro screen layout to full bleed for an immersive reveal. (why: Finish step dropoff is severe (64.8% step conversion, mean 5815s); a full-bleed intro creates a strong final reveal without adding redundant screens.)
9: [adoption, new_screen] Pet behavior style screen in adoption flow: Add a new companion behavior selection screen prior to adoption certificate generation. (why: Adoption screens benefit from step improvements, and explicit behavior selection prevents post-onboarding desktop misbehavior reports (4 emails).)

scores.note: Adoption screen redesigns consistently yield positive conversion improvements.
Adding interactive new flow screens increases friction and typically lowers conversion.
Choose path redesign has weak historical evidence but avoids negative copy changes.
Waiting step updates historically show minimal clear effect on step conversion.
High support ticket count combined with a simple copy hint makes this low-cost.
Addresses major finish step dropoff with low implementation cost.
Low cost visual badge leveraging successful adoption step focus.
Sign-in redesigns previously showed negative results and limited evidence.
Finish step dropoff is severe, but layout redesigns at finish have shown negative trends.
Adding new screens consistently harms onboarding funnel performance.
